moments.title: Community Shield 2026 in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The traditional curtain-raiser for the English football season, the FA Community Shield, takes place this Saturday at Principality Stadium in Cardiff, with Premier League champions Arsenal facing FA Cup winners Manchester City.

angles.name: Cardiff Buzz
angles.copy: Cardiff is buzzing! The Community Shield brings Arsenal vs Man City to Principality Stadium this Saturday. Who are you backing?

angles.name: National Season Kick-off
angles.copy: The Premier League season is just around the corner, but first, it's the Community Shield! Arsenal vs Manchester City this Saturday. Who takes the first silverware?

moments.title: The Hundred Cricket Final
moments.blurb: The climax of The Hundred cricket tournament arrives this Sunday, August 16, with both the men's and women's finals being played.

angles.name: Finals Day Excitement
angles.copy: It's Finals Day for The Hundred this Sunday! Who are you hoping to see lift the trophy in the Men's and Women's competitions?

angles.name: Cricket Countdown
angles.copy: The Hundred has flown by! Get ready for a massive Sunday of cricket as the finals decide this year's champions.

moments.title: Madonna & Kylie's 'Love Sensation' climbs chart
moments.blurb: Madonna and Kylie Minogue's highly anticipated collaboration, 'Love Sensation,' is set to be this week's highest new entry on the Official Singles Chart, currently at Number 8.

angles.name: Pop Royalty Team Up
angles.copy: Pop royalty unite! Madonna and Kylie's 'Love Sensation' is making a huge splash on the charts. Are you loving this collaboration?

angles.name: Chart Watch
angles.copy: Midweek chart update: 'Love Sensation' by Madonna & Kylie Minogue is heading for a Top 10 debut! Which other tracks are you streaming?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean eye 21st week at No.1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is leading the Official Singles Chart and could extend its record-breaking run to a 21st week at Number 1.

angles.name: Chart Dominance
angles.copy: Can they do it again? Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is on track for an incredible 21st week at Number 1! A modern classic?

angles.name: Record Breakers
angles.copy: Still at the top! 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean continues its historic chart reign. What's your favourite track by them?

moments.title: Happy 68th to Madonna
moments.blurb: The Queen of Pop, Madonna, celebrates her 68th birthday this Sunday, August 16.

angles.name: Pop Icon Celebration
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the one and only Queen of Pop! Madonna turns 68 this Sunday. What's your all-time favourite Madonna track?

angles.name: Madonna's Legacy
angles.copy: From 'Like A Virgin' to 'Vogue' and beyond, Madonna has redefined pop music for decades. Celebrating her 68th birthday this weekend!

moments.title: Happy 68th to Belinda Carlisle
moments.blurb: The iconic lead singer of The Go-Go's and successful solo artist, Belinda Carlisle, celebrates her 68th birthday on Monday, August 17.

angles.name: Go-Go's Icon
angles.copy: Our lips are sealed! Happy 68th birthday to the incredible Belinda Carlisle, celebrating on Monday. What's your favourite Go-Go's or solo hit?

angles.name: Heaven Is A Place On Earth
angles.copy: Belinda Carlisle turns 68 on Monday! From The Go-Go's punk-pop to her 'Heaven Is A Place On Earth' solo stardom, she's a true legend.

moments.title: Happy 50th to Ben Gibbard
moments.blurb: Ben Gibbard, frontman of Death Cab for Cutie and The Postal Service, turns 50 today, August 11.

angles.name: Indie Icon at 50
angles.copy: Happy 50th birthday to Ben Gibbard! The voice behind Death Cab for Cutie and The Postal Service. What's your go-to track?

angles.name: Death Cab for Cutie
angles.copy: Celebrating Ben Gibbard's 50th today! His songwriting has given us so many anthems with Death Cab for Cutie. Which one resonates most with you?

moments.title: Happy 72nd to Joe Jackson
moments.blurb: English singer-songwriter Joe Jackson, known for hits like 'Is She Really Going Out With Him?', celebrates his 72nd birthday today.

angles.name: New Wave Legend
angles.copy: Happy 72nd birthday to the brilliant Joe Jackson! Still wondering 'Is She Really Going Out With Him?' What's your favourite Joe Jackson tune?

moments.title: Happy 47th to Kelis
moments.blurb: Grammy-nominated R&B and soul singer Kelis, famous for 'Milkshake' and 'Caught Out There', celebrates her 47th birthday on August 21.

angles.name: R&B Queen
angles.copy: Her milkshake brings all the boys to the yard! Happy 47th birthday to the incredible Kelis, celebrating on August 21st. What's your favourite track?

moments.title: We Out Here Festival in Dorset
moments.blurb: We Out Here Festival, curated by Gilles Peterson, returns to Wimborne St Giles, Dorset, from August 20-23, celebrating jazz, soul, hip hop, house, and electronic music.

angles.name: Dorset Festival Vibes
angles.copy: We Out Here Festival kicks off in Dorset next week! Curated by Gilles Peterson, it's set for four days of incredible jazz, soul, and electronic music. Who's got tickets?

angles.name: Sold Out Success
angles.copy: Another sold-out success! We Out Here Festival is almost upon us. Get ready for a boundary-breaking musical experience in Dorset.

moments.title: Ricky Gervais' 'Alley Cats' on Netflix
moments.blurb: Ricky Gervais' new adult animated series 'Alley Cats,' featuring many of his 'After Life' stars, premiered on Netflix last Friday, August 7.

angles.name: Gervais' New Show
angles.copy: Ricky Gervais is back with 'Alley Cats' on Netflix! His new adult animated series is out now. Have you started watching?

angles.name: Foul-mouthed Felines
angles.copy: If you love Ricky Gervais' humour, his new animated series 'Alley Cats' on Netflix is a must-watch. Expect foul-mouthed feral cats and plenty of laughs!

moments.title: 'The Good Ship Murder' S3 on BritBox
moments.blurb: The third season of the popular mystery drama 'The Good Ship Murder' is now available for binge-watching on BritBox Premier, with weekly episodes for regular subscribers starting August 25.

angles.name: Cruise Ship Mysteries
angles.copy: All aboard for more mysteries! 'The Good Ship Murder' Season 3 is now streaming on BritBox. Who's ready for some holiday whodunnits?

angles.name: BritBox Binge
angles.copy: Need a new series to get stuck into? 'The Good Ship Murder' Season 3 has just dropped on BritBox. Perfect for your summer viewing!

moments.title: Local Events in Exeter Today
moments.blurb: Exeter has a host of local events happening today, including 'We're going Wild this summer!' at Guildhall Shopping Exeter, a Summer Independent Market at Princesshay, and 'Princess Play' also at Princesshay.

angles.name: Exeter Summer Fun
angles.copy: What's on in Exeter today? Lots of summer fun at Guildhall Shopping and Princesshay! 'We're going Wild', a Summer Independent Market and 'Princess Play' are all happening. Get out and enjoy!

angles.name: Princesshay Activities
angles.copy: Heading to Princesshay today? Check out the Summer Independent Market and 'Princess Play' for some family-friendly fun in Exeter!

moments.title: Scottish Schools Return This Week
moments.blurb: Many schools in Scotland are returning this week, with pupils in some areas, like South Lanarkshire, heading back on Thursday, August 13.

angles.name: Back to School Scotland
angles.copy: The summer holidays are winding down for many in Scotland, with pupils heading back to school this week! Wishing everyone a great first few days back.

angles.name: End of Summer Break
angles.copy: Where did the summer go? Scottish schools are reopening their doors this week. Good luck to all students and teachers!
